item.title: Suspected hazardous space debris located near Townsville
item.description:
The Australian Space Agency has confirmed the discovery of suspected space debris containing hazardous chemicals north of Townsville. Queensland police have enforced 50-metre exclusion zones around four objects found in the Forrest Beach area.

item.title: Norfolk Island corals face triple threat from disease and dredging
item.description:
Scientists warn that unique coral species near Norfolk Island could disappear due to disease, El Niño, and government-approved dredging. Pollution from farming and wastewater has also contributed to widespread outbreaks of algae.

item.title: Cancer Research Pioneer Stanley M. Gartler Dies at 102
item.description:
Stanley M. Gartler, a leading cancer researcher, has passed away at age 102. He was known for proving tumors develop from single mutated cells and exposing contamination involving Henrietta Lacks' cells.

item.title: NASA launches mission to rescue Swift Observatory from reentry
item.description:
NASA has partnered with Katalyst Space Technologies to save the Swift Observatory, which is at risk of burning up in Earth's atmosphere. The Link spacecraft aims to intercept the satellite and boost its orbit by 150 miles.

item.title: Food Preservatives Linked to Hypertension and Heart Disease
item.description:
A large-scale study suggests that common food preservatives may increase the risk of high blood pressure and cardiovascular disease. These additives are widely used in everyday processed foods.

item.title: New Fossil Axolotl Species Identified in Mexico
item.description:
Scientists have identified Ambystoma quetzalcoatli, the first fossil salamander formally found in Mexico. This discovery reveals that axolotls have inhabited the country for millions of years.
